players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love is dealing with an ankle issue that's not related to the high-ankle sprain he tended to in August, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Hunter Long
players.summary: Long (knee) is questionable to return against the Giants on Sunday.

players.name: Cooper Rush
players.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Saints but will serve as the emergency quarterback, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Jack Strand
players.summary: inactive

players.name: Chris Moore
players.summary: out

players.name: Durham Smythe
players.summary: out

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.summary: Jackson (ankle) is not dealing with a long-term injury, but he has "only an outside chance to play" in Week 5 and "could end up missing multiple games," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.summary: Moore (shoulder) is dealing with an injury that isn't considered long-term, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Trevor Etienne
players.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.summary: Coker (quadriceps) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Lions, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

players.name: Xavier Legette
players.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Williams (hamstring) won't practice during Week 5 and is still being classified as week-to-week rather than day-to-day, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said that Monangai is considered day-to-day after sustaining a right thumb injury in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

players.name: Tee Higgins
players.summary: Higgins (adductor), per head coach Zac Taylor, is considered day-to-day, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Colbie Young
players.summary: out

players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.summary: Chase (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

players.name: Tylan Wallace
players.summary: out

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.summary: The Broncos are confident that Bryant avoided a long-term right ankle injury after an MRI on Monday yielded good news, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Chris Brooks
players.summary: Brooks is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 4 matchup against Tampa Bay due to an ankle injury, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.summary: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he expects the Texans to open Dell's (knee) 21-day practice window this week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: British Brooks
players.summary: Brooks (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.summary: out

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Tyquan Thornton
players.summary: Thornton is slated to undergo surgery later this week to address the dislocated left ankle he sustained in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders and is facing an expected recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Jalen Nailor
players.summary: Nailor (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's contest against the Chiefs.

players.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
players.summary: Head coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that the hope is that Thornton (undisclosed) will be back at practice ahead of the Raiders' Week 5 road tilt against the Patriots, Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official site reports.

players.name: Jack Bech
players.summary: The Raiders placed Bech (forearm) on injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.summary: McConkey (foot), per head coach Jim Harbaugh, is "week-to-week," Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: out

players.name: Charlie Kolar
players.summary: out

players.name: Konata Mumpfield
players.summary: Mumpfield suffered a rotator cuff contusion during Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

players.name: Colby Parkinson
players.summary: out

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that he's viewing Douglas (ankle) as day-to-day heading into the Dolphins' Week 5 game against the Bengals, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.summary: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.summary: out

players.name: Josh Oliver
players.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Mack Hollins
players.summary: Head coach Mike Vrabel said that he expects to know more about Hollins' calf injury later Monday, and the Patriots are uncertain if the wideout will be able to practice "for a couple days," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.

players.name: Eli Raridon
players.summary: Raridon (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Buffalo.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

players.name: Zach Wilson
players.summary: Wilson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Saints' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's contest against the Falcons.

players.name: Noah Fant
players.summary: Fant (abdomen) is listed as inactive for Monday's game against the Falcons.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.summary: Tyson (hamstring) is said to be making progress and feeling good but isn't expected to be activated from injured reserve until Week 7 at the soonest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.summary: The Saints are placing Etienne (hamstring) on injured reserve, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Braxton Berrios
players.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh confirmed Berrios is dealing with a foot/ankle injury, but a decision has yet to be made regarding whether the wideout will be placed on injured reserve, Paul Schwartz of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Mason Taylor
players.summary: out

players.name: Adonai Mitchell
players.summary: out

players.name: Breece Hall
players.summary: out

players.name: Arian Smith
players.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.summary: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni didn't provide an update on Barkley's status Monday when asked about the hamstring injury the running back sustained during Sunday's loss to the Rams, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports. "We'll have more answers Wednesday probably with that stuff," Sirianni added.

players.name: Tank Bigsby
players.summary: Bigsby will undergo core muscle surgery and be placed on injured reserve, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.summary: out

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.summary: out

players.name: Hollywood Brown
players.summary: out

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.summary: Head coach Mike McCarthy said that Dowdle (toe) had a positive workout Friday and is "making progress" in his recovery, but the Steelers aren't yet certain if he'll be available to play Week 5 versus the Colts, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

players.name: Jadarian Price
players.summary: Price (chest) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Ko Kieft
players.summary: out

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.summary: out

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.summary: Head coach Dan Quinn confirmed Monday that Lane (ankle) will miss the remainder of the season.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.summary: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that White (shoulder) "should" practice this week, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.summary: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that the Commanders continue to assess what McLaurin (hamstring) may be able to do at Wednesday's practice, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.summary: Coach Dan Quinn said Monday that the Commanders are aiming for Daniels (left elbow) to have a full practice week and then start Sunday's game against the Giants, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

players.name: Marcus Mariota
players.summary: Mariota has been diagnosed with an MCL sprain in his right knee after he was forced out of Sunday's loss to the Colts in London, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.
